name: AccountSwitcher
description: Utility to swap PSN accounts on a single SD.
long_description: App to swap PSN accounts on a single SD card. It's pretty useful if you have content from multiple accounts on your card, as you can switch seamlessly between those.
requirements: Requires a jailbroken PS Vita/PSTV and installation of the VPK via VitaShell (or compatible package installer).
